whenToUse: Editing rich content as blocks: posts, pages, product descriptions, knowledge-base articles.
Mixing text blocks with page blocks (hero, gallery) in a CMS editor.
avoidWhen: A short plain description or note — use Textarea.
Structured fields with fixed shape — use a form.
a11y: Every toolbar button has a label and shortcut; the slash menu is keyboard navigable.
Block reordering has a keyboard path (Move up/down), not only drag.
